shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
concentric circle / disc motif worn on the body
figure adorned with ornaments (band/headgear, necklace or bracelet)
low-relief carved detail on the body surface
justification: Both depict a single large anthropomorphic figure bearing circular disc/rosette-like ornaments in low relief on the body, which is the only reasonably specific correspondence and one many traditions could reach independently. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a frontal, columnar, radically schematic figure with blocky featureless head and abstract chest emblems, while B is a profile, anatomically detailed winged figure with beard, muscled arms, feathered wings and a held object, engaged in a specific action.
